name: Mukaidou Kaede
source:
A student at St. Celine's School. She is the daughter of a large conglomerate, and is an extremely well-known young lady.

She is the captain of the prestigious St. Celine's tennis club and a promising ace. She is also a proven competitor, and is considered a candidate to win the Inter-High School Championships.

She has been told that she is a noble person and has never been treated as an equal by the people around her, so she has an ultra standoffish personality and is very stubborn. However, she is quite pure-hearted at heart. She is also a spoiled brat.

She is attracted to the main character who talks to her as an equal even though she knows that she is the daughter of a big conglomerate.
